command: uv run --locked --all-packages uvicorn db_pipelines.service:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18020 --reload
    working_dir: ./04-shared-services/db-services/gesetze-normen-db-service
    environment:
      - DB_HOST=localhost
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - DB_NAME=gesetze-normen
      - LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG
      - TEMPORAL_HOST=localhost:7233
    readiness_probe:
      http_get:
        host: localhost
        port: 18020
        path: /docs
      initial_delay_seconds: 20
      period_seconds: 5
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  gesetzesbegruendung-db:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages uvicorn begruendungen_db.service:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18021 --reload
    working_dir: ./04-shared-services/db-services/gesetzesbegruendung-db-service
    environment:
      - DB_HOST=localhost
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - DB_NAME=begruendungen-db
      - GESETZE_NORMEN_URL=http://localhost:18020
      - LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG
      - TEMPORAL_HOST=http://localhost:7233
      - CHUNKING_PROVIDER=litellm
      - CHUNKING_MODEL=${LITELLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL}
      - CHUNKING_URL=${LITELLM_BASE_URL}
      - CHUNKING_APIKEY=${LITELLM_MASTER_KEY}
    readiness_probe:
      http_get:
        host: localhost
        port: 18021
        path: /docs
      initial_delay_seconds: 20
      period_seconds: 5
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3
    depends_on:
      gesetze-normen-db:
        condition: process_healthy

  jura-db:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages uvicorn jura_db.service:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18022 --reload
    working_dir: ./04-shared-services/db-services/jura-db-service
    environment:
      - DB_HOST=localhost
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - DB_NAME=jura-db
      - GESETZE_NORMEN_URL=http://localhost:18020
      - LOG_LEVEL=INFO
      - TEMPORAL_HOST=http://localhost:7233
      - CHUNKING_PROVIDER=litellm
      - CHUNKING_MODEL=${LITELLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL}
      - CHUNKING_URL=${LITELLM_BASE_URL}
      - CHUNKING_APIKEY=${LITELLM_MASTER_KEY}
    readiness_probe:
      http_get:
        host: localhost
        port: 18022
        path: /docs
      initial_delay_seconds: 20
      period_seconds: 5
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3
    depends_on:
      gesetze-normen-db:
        condition: process_healthy

  rechtsaenderungs-monitoring:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages uvicorn rechtsaenderungsmonitoring.service:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18024 --reload
    working_dir: ./04-shared-services/basiskomponenten/rechtsaenderungs-monitoring
    environment:
      - DB_HOST=localhost
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - DB_NAME=rechtsaenderungsmonitoring-db
      - GESETZE_NORMEN_URL=http://localhost:18020
      - LOG_LEVEL=INFO
      - TEMPORAL_HOST=localhost:7233
    readiness_probe:
      http_get:
        host: localhost
        port: 18024
        path: /docs
      initial_delay_seconds: 20
      period_seconds: 5
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  llm-client:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python -m llm_client.worker
    working_dir: ./04-shared-services/llm/llm-client
    environment:
      - LITELLM_DISK_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/spark-workflow-llm-cache
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  worker-gesetze-normen-db:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python -m db_pipelines.worker
    working_dir: ./04-shared-services/db-services/gesetze-normen-db-service
    environment:
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=gesetze-normen-db-worker
      - TEMPORAL_JOB_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:18015
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  worker-rechtsaenderungs-monitoring:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python rechtsaenderungsmonitoring/worker.py
    working_dir: ./04-shared-services/basiskomponenten/rechtsaenderungs-monitoring
    environment:
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - GESETZE_NORMEN_URL=http://localhost:18020
      - OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=rechtsaenderungsmonitoring-worker
      - OTEL_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4317
      - TEMPORAL_JOB_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:18015
      - LLM_CATEGORISATION_MODEL=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
      - LLM_SUMMARISATION_MODEL=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
      - LLM_ENRICHMENT_MODEL=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  worker-jura-db:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python -m jura_db.worker
    working_dir: ./04-shared-services/db-services/jura-db-service
    environment:
      - DB_HOST=localhost
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - DB_NAME=jura-db
      - GESETZE_NORMEN_URL=http://localhost:18020
      - LOG_LEVEL=INFO
      - CHUNKING_PROVIDER=litellm
      - CHUNKING_MODEL=${LITELLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL}
      - CHUNKING_URL=${LITELLM_BASE_URL}
      - CHUNKING_APIKEY=${LITELLM_MASTER_KEY}
      - OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=jura-db-worker
      - TEMPORAL_JOB_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:18015
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  worker-begruendungen-db:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python -m begruendungen_db.worker
    working_dir: ./04-shared-services/db-services/gesetzesbegruendung-db-service
    environment:
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - GESETZE_NORMEN_URL=http://localhost:18020
      - OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=begruendungen-db-worker
      - OTEL_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4317
      - TEMPORAL_JOB_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:18015
      - DOCLING_HOST=${DOCLING_BASE_URL}
      - DOCLING_TIMEOUT=600
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  worker-formale-pruefung:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python main.py
    working_dir: ./05-modulcluster/modul-formale-pruefung
    environment:
      - DMS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18001
      - TEMPORAL_JOB_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:18015
      - LITELLM_MODEL=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
      - OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=formale-pruefung-worker
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  worker-risikohinweiser:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python main.py
    working_dir: ./05-modulcluster/modul-risikohinweiser
    environment:
      - LITELLM_MODEL=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
      - OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=risikohinweiser
      - TEMPORAL_JOB_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:18015
      - TEMPORAL_LLM_MAX_PER_SECOND=3
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  worker-inhaltsextraktion:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python main.py
    working_dir: ./05-modulcluster/modul-inhaltsextraktion
    environment:
      - DMS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18001
      - QDRANT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:6333
      - TEMPORAL_JOB_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:18015
      - INJECTION_LLM_SCAN_ENABLED=false
      - INJECTION_MODEL_URL=http://localhost:18001
      - KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID=${DOCLING_CLIENT_ID}
      - KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET=${DOCLING_CLIENT_SECRET}
      - KEYCLOAK_TOKEN_URL=${DOCLING_TOKEN_URL}
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  worker-rechtsmethodik:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python main.py
    working_dir: ./05-modulcluster/modul-rechtsmethodik
    environment:
      - LEGAL_DEFINITION_POSTGRES_HOST=localhost
      - LEGAL_DEFINITION_POSTGRES_PORT=5432
      - LAW_DATABASE_DOCUMENTS_URL=http://localhost:18020/documents/
      - LAW_DATABASE_NORMS_SEARCH_URL=http://localhost:18020/norms/search
      - LAW_DATABASE_ABSATZ_JURABK_URL=http://localhost:18020/absatz/{jurabk}
      - LAW_DATABASE_DOCUMENTS_SEARCH_TERM_URL=http://localhost:18020/documents/search/{search_term}
      - LAW_DATABASE_DOCUMENTS_JURABK_URL=http://localhost:18020/documents/{jurabk}
      - LAW_DATABASE_LEGALDEFINITIONEN_JURABK_URL=http://localhost:18020/legaldefinitionen/{jurabk}
      - LAW_DATABASE_TECHNISCHE_NORMEN_DOKUMENT_URL=http://localhost:18020/technische-normen/{dokument}
      - LAW_DATABASE_QUERY_TOP_K_DR_URL=http://localhost:18021/query_top_k
      - LAW_DATABASE_QUERY_K_RESULTS_UT_URL=http://localhost:18022/query_k_results
      - LAW_DATABASE_QUERY_CHUNKS_UT_URL=http://localhost:18022/chunks
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  worker-bewertung:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python main.py
    working_dir: ./05-modulcluster/modul-bewertung
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  worker-einwendungsmanagement:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python main.py
    working_dir: ./05-modulcluster/modul-einwendungsmanagement
    environment:
      - DMS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18001
      - TEMPORAL_JOB_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:18015
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  worker-suche-und-zuordnung:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python main.py
    working_dir: ./05-modulcluster/modul-suche-und-zuordnung
    environment:
      - DMS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18001
      - DMS_FVP_URL=http://localhost:18002
      - FCS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18002
      - LAW_DATABASE_DKE_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18021
      - LAW_DATABASE_UT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18022
      - QDRANT_HOST=localhost
      - QDRANT_PORT=6333
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  worker-plausibilitaet-pruefung:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python main.py
    working_dir: ./05-modulcluster/modul-plausibilitaet-pruefung
    environment:
      - DMS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18001
      - QDRANT_CLUSTER_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:6333
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  worker-anonymisierung:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python main.py
    working_dir: ./05-modulcluster/modul-anonymisierung
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  frontend:
    # Served behind oauth2-proxy (docker-compose) which owns http://localhost:3000
    # and enforces the Keycloak login before proxying to this dev server.
    command: pnpm dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3002
    working_dir: ./01-frontend/frontend
    environment:
      - VITE_DEV_API_MODE=port-forwarding
      # Browser-facing URLs: localhost, or the public https://<port>-$WEB_HOST values that
      # create_secrets.sh wrote to .env. The S3 origins must equal the origin of the presigned
      # URLs (S3_EXTERNAL_URL on the document-management service below).
      - VITE_API_BASE_URL=${FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL}
      - VITE_APP_BASE_PATH=/app
      - VITE_TEMPORAL_UI_BASE_URL=${TEMPORAL_UI_PUBLIC_URL}
      - VITE_ALLOWED_DOWNLOAD_ORIGINS=${S3_PUBLIC_URL}
      - VITE_ALLOWED_UPLOAD_ORIGINS=${S3_PUBLIC_URL}
      - VITE_PLS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18000/openapi.json
      - VITE_DMS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18001/openapi.json
      - VITE_FCS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18002/openapi.json
      - VITE_AOM_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18003/openapi.json
      - VITE_TEMPORAL_JOBS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18015/openapi.json
      - VITE_PNS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18005/openapi.json
      - VITE_OMS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18006/openapi.json
      - VITE_SUPPLEMENTARY_REQUESTS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18012/openapi.json
      - VITE_COMMENTS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18008/openapi.json
      - VITE_EXAMINATION_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18009/openapi.json
      - VITE_VAE_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18010/openapi.json
      - VITE_LAW_CHANGES_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18024/openapi.json
      - VITE_IDENTITY_MANAGEMENT_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18013/openapi.json
      - VITE_FEEDBACK_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18011/openapi.json
      - VITE_PROTOCOL_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18016/openapi.json
      - VITE_LOCAL_USER_ID=${LOCAL_USER_ID}
      - VITE_LOCAL_USER_EMAIL=${LOCAL_USER_EMAIL}
      - VITE_LOCAL_USER_FIRST_NAME=${LOCAL_USER_FIRST_NAME}
      - VITE_LOCAL_USER_LAST_NAME=${LOCAL_USER_LAST_NAME}
      - ALLOW_DEV_MODE=true
      - VITE_ENABLE_EWMS_FEATURE=true
      - VITE_ENABLE_AUTH_REDIRECT_RETRY=true
      - VITE_SYSTEM_LOAD_DISABLE_THRESHOLD_PERCENTAGE=500

    readiness_probe:
      http_get:
        host: localhost
        port: 3002
        path: /app/
      initial_delay_seconds: 10
      period_seconds: 5
    depends_on:
      project-logic:
        condition: process_healthy
      project-logic-seed:
        condition: process_completed_successfully
      document-management:
        condition: process_healthy
      formal-completeness:
        condition: process_healthy
      formal-completeness-seed:
        condition: process_completed_successfully
      agent-orchestration:
        condition: process_healthy
      plausibility-notes:
        condition: process_healthy
      objections-management:
        condition: process_healthy
      comment:
        condition: process_healthy
      examination:
